description: A leaderboard where app users collect points and see who ranks first today, this week, this month and overall.

events.name: scoreUpdated
events.description: Someone's score on the leaderboard changed.

changeType.description: How the score changed: add when points were added, edit when today's score was changed.

points.description: The points added, or the new score for today.

operations.name: listScores
operations.description: Shows the leaderboard for today, this week, this month or overall, highest score first.

period.description: Which leaderboard to show. Leave it out to show the overall one.

user.description: Only show this person's place, by their user id or email. Leave it out to show everyone.

callback.description: Runs when the leaderboard is ready.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as a leaderboard that doesn't exist.

period.description: Which leaderboard this is: daily, weekly, monthly or overall.

scores.description: The people on the leaderboard, highest score first.

rank.description: Their place on the leaderboard, starting at 1.

displayName.description: The person's name, as shown on the leaderboard.

operations.name: updateUserScore
operations.description: Adds points to a person's score for today, this week, this month and overall, on behalf of the app.

user.description: The person to give the points to, by their user id or email.

points.description: How many points to add, as a whole number.

callback.description: Runs when the points are added.

error.description: Why no points were added, such as no person having that email, or points coming only from questionnaires.

result.description: The person's scores after the change.

displayName.description: The person's name, as shown on the leaderboard.

operations.name: updateUserScoresAdvanced
operations.description: Adds points to several people's scores at once, up to 50.

scores.description: Who gets how many points, up to 50 people at a time.

user.description: The person to give the points to, by their user id or email.

points.description: How many points to add, as a whole number.

callback.description: Runs when everyone's points are done.

error.description: Why no points were added, such as an entry missing its points or the same person listed twice.

scores.description: One result per entry, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which entry this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The person's id, if their points were added.

error.description: Why their points weren't added, if they weren't.

operations.name: updateUserDailyScore
operations.description: Changes a person's score for today, moving their week, month and overall scores by the same amount, on behalf of the app.

user.description: The person whose score for today changes, by their user id or email.

newScore.description: The person's new score for today, as a whole number.

callback.description: Runs when the score is changed.

error.description: Why the score wasn't changed, such as no person having that email, or points coming only from questionnaires.

result.description: The person's scores after the change.

displayName.description: The person's name, as shown on the leaderboard.

operations.name: updateUserDailyScoresAdvanced
operations.description: Changes several people's scores for today at once, up to 50.

scores.description: Who gets which score for today, up to 50 people at a time.

user.description: The person whose score for today changes, by their user id or email.

newScore.description: The person's new score for today, as a whole number.

callback.description: Runs when everyone's scores are done.

error.description: Why no scores were changed, such as an entry missing its score or the same person listed twice.

scores.description: One result per entry, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which entry this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The person's id, if their score was changed.

error.description: Why their score wasn't changed, if it wasn't.

operations.name: resetLeaderboard
operations.description: Permanently clears every score from today's, this week's, this month's and the overall leaderboard.

callback.description: Runs when the leaderboard is cleared.

error.description: Why it didn't work, if it didn't.

items.description: One leaderboard: daily, weekly, monthly or overall.

operations.name: getSettings
operations.description: Shows how people earn points and when rank change notifications go out.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are ready.

error.description: Why it didn't work, if it didn't.

notificationsFrequency.description: Which leaderboards send a notification when the top three change.

items.description: One of dailyChange, weeklyChange, monthlyChange or allTimeChange.

userEarnPoints.description: How people earn points: HONOR_SYSTEM when they enter their own, SCORE_FROM_FREE_TEXT_QUESTIONNAIRE when points come from questionnaires.

features.description: The questionnaires that give points, in order.

action.description: The kind of link, usually to another feature of the app.

instanceId.description: The questionnaire feature it links to.

order.description: Its place in the list, counting from 0.

calculateLoyaltyPoints.description: Whether points from the loyalty feature are added to people's scores.

operations.name: updateSettings
operations.description: Changes how people earn points and when rank change notifications go out.

notifyOnDailyChange.description: Whether a notification goes out when the top three of today's leaderboard change. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

notifyOnWeeklyChange.description: Whether a notification goes out when the top three of this week's leaderboard change. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

notifyOnMonthlyChange.description: Whether a notification goes out when the top three of this month's leaderboard change. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

notifyOnOverallChange.description: Whether a notification goes out when the top three of the overall leaderboard change. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

userEarnPoints.description: Whether people enter their own points or get them from questionnaires. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

questionnaires.description: The questionnaires that give points, each a link to a questionnaire feature of the app, in order. Replaces the current list; leave it out to keep it, or leave it empty to remove them all.

calculateLoyaltyPoints.description: Whether points from the loyalty feature are added to people's scores. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are saved.

error.description: Why the settings weren't saved, such as a choice that isn't offered or nothing to change.

result.description: The settings as they are now.

notificationsFrequency.description: Which leaderboards send a notification when the top three change.

items.description: One of dailyChange, weeklyChange, monthlyChange or allTimeChange.

userEarnPoints.description: How people earn points: HONOR_SYSTEM when they enter their own, SCORE_FROM_FREE_TEXT_QUESTIONNAIRE when points come from questionnaires.

features.description: The questionnaires that give points, in order.

action.description: The kind of link, usually to another feature of the app.

instanceId.description: The questionnaire feature it links to.

order.description: Its place in the list, counting from 0.

calculateLoyaltyPoints.description: Whether points from the loyalty feature are added to people's scores.

operations.name: getIntroduction
operations.description: Shows the pictures and the text shown behind the leaderboard.

callback.description: Runs when the introduction is ready.

error.description: Why it didn't work, if it didn't.

carouselItems.description: The pictures shown at the top, in order.

action.description: What happens when someone taps it.

description.description: The formatted text shown below the pictures.

operations.name: updateIntroduction
operations.description: Changes the pictures and the text shown behind the leaderboard.

carouselItems.description: The pictures shown at the top, in order, each with what happens when someone taps it. Replaces the current pictures; leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty to remove them all.

description.description: The formatted text shown below the pictures. Leave it out to keep the current text, or leave it empty to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when the introduction is saved.

error.description: Why it wasn't saved, such as a picture without an image or nothing to change.

result.description: The introduction as it is now.

carouselItems.description: The pictures shown at the top, in order.

action.description: What happens when someone taps it.
